title: A haiku sequence: five individual haiku
author: Randy Brooks
text:
sprouts just up
the curvature
of rainwater

distant thunder . . .
long leaves curl in
on themselves

sunlit kernels
pour into the wagon
sky ablaze

some of the harvest
spilled at the STOP sign
a clutter of starlings

rising sun
new snow between rows
of stubble

•

five haiku or senryu:

a grandson`s drawing
now I can speak
firefly

•

ballet dancers
crowd a backstage doorway
snowflakes

•

a bruised pear
returned to Mother`s basket
day of atonement

•

catching up
with the two-year-old
grandpa`s day bed

•

knee high corn
a sparrow out of its nest
too soon
stanzas: a sparrow out of its nest
